script_hooks.logic:
Let aiArg be the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let hpRate be the HP fraction of the enemy.
Let v be nothing.
If the numeric entry "hp_rate_message_2" in aiArg is less than hpRate and the numeric entry "hp_rate_message_1" in aiArg is at least hpRate, then set v to "02".
Otherwise, if hpRate is at most the numeric entry "hp_rate_message_2" in aiArg, then set v to "03".
Return v.
